instruction: I need to send packages from Futian District, Shenzhen. Please help me find the addresses of 3 post offices in Futian District and save them in Chinese to this open Word document.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "s"); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.press("enter");

metadata.explanation: Task requires searching for 3 邮局 locations in Futian District, Shenzhen and saving them in Chinese to the Word document. The evaluator checks if at least 3 location entries are present in the document with partial credit for fewer locations.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Full score (1.0) for 3+ locations, partial credit proportional to locations found
metadata.verification: The metric counts non-empty paragraphs with length > 5 characters as location entries. Score = min(actual_count / 3, 1.0)

Evaluator correctly checks for post office keywords (邮局/邮政) to verify facility type

Appropriate minimum length threshold (15 characters) filters out trivial text
